en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a town square with a small fountain in the center, surrounded by ornate multi‑story buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk, stand by carts, and shop at market stalls with umbrellas. One prominent building bears the sign "BANCA COOPERATIVA" on its roofline. At the top of the postcard, in red lettering, is the caption "Trento. Piazza della Posta."
